topography.project_purpose: Yield Yak is an Avalanche-focused DeFi yield optimizer that provides set-and-forget, autocompounding yield vaults. Users deposit assets into vaults that automatically reinvest rewards to maximize returns. The protocol also offers a liquid staking token for AVAX.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Yield Yak Aggregator and Staked Avax families share the YAK token for governance and incentives. The YAK token is used across both families, with staking mechanisms (YyStaking) supporting the aggregator's tokenomics.
